name: rust-engineering
description: Automatic Rust engineering orchestration with 50 focused skills, a 265-rule coding rulebook, and reviewed Actionbook, Huiali, and low-level protocols.

interface.shortDescription: Route Rust work through focused skills.
interface.longDescription: Starts with a fast read-only Rust context hook, then routes implementation through one primary and at most two supporting engineering profiles. A progressive-disclosure overlay selects up to eight relevant rules from 265 addressable Rust coding rules. Adapted Actionbook and Huiali protocols add cross-layer design and specialized Rust models. Reviewed low-level protocols add debugging, profiling, Cargo build-time, cross-target, sanitizer/Miri, async-internal, security, and hardware workflows behind official-evidence and command-safety gates, without adding automatic heavy hooks.
defaultPrompt: Use $rust-workflow to route this Rust change, apply relevant $rust-coding-rules, implement it, and verify the result.
